description: Click an element by its ref from the latest snapshot. Supports right/middle button, double-click, and modifier keys (ctrl/shift/alt/meta) for context menus, multi-select, and open-in-new-tab.

button.description: Mouse button (default left). 'right' opens context menus.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the click.

ref.description: Element ref, e.g. e12, from browser_snapshot.

name: browser_click
